messages.subject: Murat | Energy, Mining & Utilities Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Middle East Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Murat,

Your executive-search work across Turkey, the Middle East and CIS, together with your Energy, Mining & Utilities and Government specialisations, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where resource-sector leadership depends on government relations, ESG and country-facing execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. Earlier experience in regulated financial services adds a strong governance and institutional dimension.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am open to wider Middle East, European and international assignments.

I have attached a TRANSEARCH-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where this profile fits.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
